verdict.rationale: Nix's own documented commands `nix-shell` and `nix develop` start a shell in which a project's declared dependencies are provided and all necessary environment variables are set. That covers the 'right tool versions and environment variables' half of the story, and Nix supports multiple package versions side by side. However, the evidence only shows activation by explicitly running a command: nothing documents the environment activating automatically when you enter a project directory. Missing for 10: documented automatic on-directory-entry activation (e.g. a shell hook or direnv-style integration), and independent hands-on corroboration of per-project environment switching.
